title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 015
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute key and edit variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Small round headed key with two short teeth on a straight shaft
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the simplest upright key silhouette with a round head.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the angled or paired key icons when the straight vertical key is intended.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the smallest and simplest key with a straight shaft and two side teeth.

items.depicts_observation: Standard key with a round head hole an angled shoulder and two bottom teeth
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a more classic side view key with a round head opening.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the upright or paired keys when the angled body should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses the most familiar angled key body with a round head and toothed base.

items.depicts_observation: Two keys hanging together with round heads and overlapping shafts
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants to show multiple keys grouped together rather than one single key.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for lone keys when the icon clearly shows two overlapping key shapes.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows two keys linked together instead of one isolated key silhouette.

items.depicts_observation: Two outline keys side by side with mirrored shafts and round heads
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a balanced double key symbol rather than overlapping loose keys.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the hanging key pair when the two keys should read as parallel outlines.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows two parallel key outlines instead of the overlapping keyring style from key_3.

items.depicts_observation: Document outline with two short text lines and a small pencil badge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants editing attached to a document or file rather than a free pencil.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the standalone edit icons when the file outline is the key visible cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot combines a file outline and a small pencil badge instead of only showing a pencil.
